speaker: Jordan
text: We'll keep this short. You overbilled us by four hundred thousand and we are not paying it.

speaker: Sam
text: What Jordan means is that we want to understand how the number got there.

speaker: Riley
text: It got there because Fawn approved the oak upgrade while Pat was on vacation. Everyone knows that.

speaker: Morgan
text: Riley, let them finish.

speaker: Jordan
text: Approved by someone with no authority to approve it.

speaker: Riley
text: Someone you left in charge. Your choice, your problem.

speaker: Sandy
text: Can we not. Morgan, what's the number if we strip the oak back to the original spec?

speaker: Morgan
text: Hang on. Original spec was one million forty, not one million. I have the bid here.

speaker: Sam
text: Thank you, that matters. So the gap is three sixty, not four hundred.

speaker: Jordan
text: Three sixty we're not paying either.

speaker: Sam
text: Hold on. Sandy, what would it take to get this resolved this week?

speaker: Sandy
text: Supplier paid by the fifteenth. That's the only thing that matters this week.

speaker: Riley
text: Which wouldn't be a problem if someone had answered the phone in March.

speaker: Morgan
text: Riley. The phone doesn't help us now. What helps is a date and a number.

speaker: Pat
text: I can release the million in escrow by Monday.

speaker: Jordan
text: Pat, we discussed holding that.

speaker: Pat
text: And I'm deciding not to. Sam, note that down.

speaker: Sam
text: Noted. Can I suggest we take five minutes before the three sixty?

speaker: Sandy
text: Yes. Five minutes.

speaker: Morgan
text: Okay. We're back. On the three sixty: what if it's paid out of the spring projects rather than cash?

speaker: Jordan
text: There won't be spring projects if this is how you negotiate.

speaker: Sam
text: There will be spring projects. We need a crew and Sandy's is the best one we've had.

speaker: Riley
text: Funny way of showing it.

speaker: Morgan
text: Riley. Please.

speaker: Sandy
text: Spring work against the three sixty. At what discount?

speaker: Pat
text: Ten percent on both projects, and the three sixty is deducted from the first invoice.

speaker: Morgan
text: So the supplier gets the million Monday, the loan stays as is, the three sixty comes out of spring at ten percent off. Correct?

speaker: Sam
text: Correct.

speaker: Jordan
text: I still think we're being generous.

speaker: Sandy
text: You are. Thank you for it.

speaker: Riley
text: Fine. Write it up.
